candidates.source_name: MPSV / Úřad práce ČR – Jednotný portál, evidence volných pracovních míst
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national vacancy register: employers (including banks and their IT/procurement units) must notify vacancies to Úřad práce. Gives an official, structured, non-paywalled stream of hiring signals (e.g. 'projektový manažer migrace', 'manažer dodavatelů', 'karetní systémy') that precede a formal tender by 6-18 months.
candidates.access_status: public, free, web search form; no documented open API
candidates.legal_status: public sector information; ToS of gov portal applies
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyword search of the vacancy search form (CZ-NACE 64/66 + keyword list) and diff of result sets; low-rate polling, respect scheduled outages (portal migration announced Aug-Sep 2026).
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles: who must publish hiring by law
queries_used: integrovaný portál MPSV volná pracovní místa databáze úřad práce vyhledávání

candidates.source_name: Jobs.cz (LMC) – main Czech professional job board
candidates.why_relevant: Dominant CZ white-collar job board; the major banks run their branded microsites on it (kb.jobs.cz, csob.jobs.cz). Role titles such as 'projektový manažer migrace jádrového systému', 'specialista nákupu', 'produktový manažer karty' are the earliest observable indicator of a coming platform/POS replacement programme.
candidates.access_status: public listings; search by keyword and company
candidates.legal_status: commercial ToS likely restricts bulk scraping; check robots.txt and LMC terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Saved keyword searches + RSS/e-mail alerts where offered; manual/low-volume fetch of listing pages rather than bulk crawl, to stay within ToS.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search + snowball from bank career pages
queries_used: volné pracovní místo "migrace" "jádrový systém" banka Praha projektový manažer
kariéra banka vendor manager nákup ČSOB Česká spořitelna Komerční banka kariérní portál

candidates.source_name: Prace.cz – second-tier Czech job board
candidates.why_relevant: Complementary CZ job board; catches bank supplier/integrator postings (staffing agencies recruiting for bank programmes) that never appear on the bank's own site — an indirect view of which vendor is already staffing a programme.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword alerts; targeted page fetches for shortlisted roles.
queries_used: volné pracovní místo "migrace" "jádrový systém" banka Praha projektový manažer

candidates.source_name: Komerční banka career portal (kariera.kb.cz / kb.jobs.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: First-party hiring signal from a top-3 CZ bank. KB has a dedicated IT & technology recruitment stream; postings naming a transformation/migration programme, card platform or vendor management reveal buying intent long before any RFP.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly snapshot of the IT/technology and procurement categories; diff titles and descriptions; flag programme names.
queries_used: kariéra banka vendor manager nákup ČSOB Česká spořitelna Komerční banka kariérní portál

candidates.source_name: Česká spořitelna career portal (kariera.csas.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Largest CZ retail bank by clients; its own vacancy list is the cleanest first-party signal of internal programmes (payments, cards, merchant acquiring, procurement) that later become tenders or vendor negotiations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly listing snapshot + diff; keyword filter on migrace/karty/akceptace/dodavatel.
queries_used: kariéra banka vendor manager nákup ČSOB Česká spořitelna Komerční banka kariérní portál

candidates.source_name: ČSOB career listings (csob.jobs.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: KBC-group bank; hiring for payments/cards/IT-transformation roles indicates group-driven platform programmes with CZ local execution — a lead indicator for local sourcing decisions.

candidates.source_name: ČNB – výběrová řízení (Czech National Bank vacancies)
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator/operator of CERTIS payment infrastructure. Vacancies in payment-systems, IT infrastructure or procurement units signal ČNB-side infrastructure projects (instant payments, CERTIS modernisation) that pull the whole market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly page snapshot and diff.

candidates.source_name: LinkedIn – Czech banking/payments job listings and role-change feed
candidates.why_relevant: The single richest source for both (a) English-language bank/vendor job ads naming programmes ('core banking migration', 'card platform', 'merchant acquiring') and (b) role changes — a new Head of Payments or Procurement Director is a classic precursor to a re-tender.
candidates.access_status: largely login-walled; anonymous access limited and rate-restricted
candidates.legal_status: ToS explicitly prohibits scraping; use only manual/authorised access or official APIs
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual analyst review with a saved-search routine, or licensed data (LinkedIn Talent Insights / Sales Navigator). Do not scrape.
queries_used: LinkedIn jobs Czech bank payments core banking migration Prague hiring 2026
candidates.observed_blocker: Login wall on most job and profile pages; ToS bars automated collection

candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates English-language bank vacancies in Prague, useful as a cross-check for roles not posted in Czech; also surfaces vendor/consultancy roles staffed against bank programmes.

candidates.source_name: Indeed CZ – banking/manager roles
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregator that mirrors postings from bank sites and agencies; convenient single query surface for keyword monitoring across many employers.

candidates.source_name: Hays Czech Republic – banking & insurance recruitment

candidates.source_name: cardforum (SBK) – annual Czech payment-cards conference
candidates.why_relevant: The single most on-point event for this cell: organised by Sdružení pro bankovní karty, attended by CZ card issuers, acquirers and terminal vendors. Agendas and speaker lists name the banks and the exact programmes (tokenisation, acceptance modernisation, terminal estate) — a direct read on who is about to buy. Programme is broadcast, and PDF programme files are published per edition.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of /data/cardforumYYYYinfo.pdf plus programme pages; extract speaker names, employers, session titles into an actor map.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language search for an explicit bank vacancy naming core-banking migration ('projektový manažer migrace jádrového systému', Praha) returned only generic job-board landing pages, no live matching posting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines surface board homepages and category pages rather than individual expiring vacancy detail pages; such postings are short-lived and mostly indexed behind board search forms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This cell's core signal is not reachable by open web search alone — it requires standing keyword alerts on the boards themselves, otherwise the earliest lead indicator is missed.

negative_findings.description: No stable Czech term was confirmed for the role 'vendor manager' in a banking context; searches on 'manažer dodavatelů' / 'nákup' returned no bank-specific postings.
negative_findings.result_summary: CZ banks appear to use either the English title or umbrella terms (nákup, procurement, supplier management) inconsistently, so a single local keyword will not catch these roles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword lists for automated monitoring must be bilingual and generous ('vendor manager', 'supplier manager', 'manažer dodavatelů', 'specialista nákupu', 'procurement specialist') or recall will be poor.

negative_findings.description: No Czech conference or brand named 'Cashless' (as given in the cell brief) was located for the CZ market.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches around CZ payment-card events surfaced cardforum/SBK, Trendy v platebním styku, ČBA events and Retail Summit instead; 'Cashless' appears to be a non-CZ brand or a mis-scoped seed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The event watchlist for this cell should be rebuilt from cardforum/ČBA/Blue Events/konferenceseminare rather than from the 'Cashless' seed.

negative_findings.description: Money Motion, named in the cell brief as a CZ signal, is held in Zagreb, Croatia — not Prague.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed via the event's own site: editions at Zagreb Fair, March.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Treat it as a regional, low-priority source; do not count it toward CZ event coverage.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn, Glassdoor and Indeed — the three highest-value aggregators for hiring and role-change signals — are login-walled and/or bot-defended, and their terms restrict automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only landing/aggregate pages were reachable via search; no listing content could be enumerated openly. Not verified as dead, only as restricted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest part of this cell cannot be automated legally; budget for analyst time or licensed data, and lean on first-party bank career pages plus the MPSV register for machine collection.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language search for 2026 bank executive appointments in IT/cards ('jmenován', 'novým ředitelem') returned mostly ČNB and Česká pošta personnel news, no commercial-bank payments/IT appointment.
negative_findings.result_summary: Role-change news for commercial banks is dispersed across trade press and LinkedIn rather than concentrated in a searchable feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A dedicated appointments watchlist (bankovnictvionline.cz, MediaGuru, ManagementNews, EduCity personální změny) is needed rather than ad-hoc search.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured, automatable feed identified for role changes / executive appointments at CZ commercial banks; candidate aggregators (ManagementNews, EduCity 'Personální změny', MediaGuru) were seen only as search hits and not assessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicate a follow-up pass to CZ 'personální změny' aggregators and to bank press-room appointment sections; assess feed availability and coverage of IT/payments roles.

coverage_gaps.description: Career pages were captured for KB, ČS, ČSOB and ČNB only. Missing: Moneta, Raiffeisenbank, UniCredit CZ/SK, Air Bank/PPF, Fio, mBank, Trinity/Creditas, plus acquirers and processors (Global Payments CZ, Worldline, Nexi, ČSOB acquiring) and integrators.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a complete registry of career-page and press-room URLs for all CZ banks, acquirers/processors and their integrators before starting collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Startup/tech-specific CZ job boards (StartupJobs.cz, Welcome to the Jungle CZ, Techloop) were not searched; these carry fintech and vendor engineering roles that mainstream boards miss.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over CZ tech job boards with the bilingual keyword list.

coverage_gaps.description: Several conference sources were assessed from search snippets rather than fetched agenda pages; per-edition programme URL patterns (beyond cardforum's /data/cardforumYYYYinfo.pdf) are unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each event's current programme page to confirm URL patterns and whether speaker lists are public or gated, before scheduling collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-side signals (Printec competitors' and partners' own press releases, case studies and award submissions announcing CZ bank wins) were not systematically enumerated in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a vendor press-room registry (terminal makers, processors, core-banking vendors active in CZ) as a mirror-image confirmation channel for partnership/pilot signals.

brief: For Czech weak signals, the usable landscape splits three ways: hiring, events, and announcements. Hiring is best served by first-party bank career portals (kariera.kb.cz, kariera.csas.cz, csob.jobs.cz, cnb.cz) plus the statutory MPSV/Úřad práce vacancy register, because the highest-value aggregators (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor) are login-walled or ToS-restricted and realistically need analyst time or licensed access rather than crawling. Events are unusually concentrated and high-yield: cardforum (run by Sdružení pro bankovní karty), Trendy v platebním styku, the ČBA event calendar, Fintech Roadmap and Retail Summit together name almost everyone who owns a payments or card-platform budget in the country, and their agendas are public. Partnership/pilot and award signals come from bank press rooms, the MPO 'Česko platí kartou' programme, SystemOnline's banking-IT case studies and Zlatá koruna. The main structural gap is role-change monitoring, for which no clean automatable Czech feed was found in this pass.
